name: Radon Number of the Three-Code Class
proof: The whole three-concept class is Radon independent.  For each partition into a singleton and a pair, the pair agrees on one coordinate on which the singleton disagrees: $011,101$ agree at $x_0=1$; $000,101$ agree at $x_1=0$; and $000,011$ agree at $x_2=0$.  The pair's convex hull is consequently disjoint from the singleton's hull.  This checks every nontrivial partition, and no Radon-independent subset can have more than the three available concepts.
